added.summary: Turns the hue of everything a composed effect instance draws, in radians about the grey axis, after its tint (default 0): the same fire drawn blue for ice (about 3.1) or green for poison, white, grey and black unchanged. Its particles and meshes turn their whole drawn colour, textures included; its trails', beams', lights' and decals' colours turn, and a coloured trail, beam or decal texture keeps its own colours.
